title: Workshop reservation by visitors
purpose: Document the request to let visitors reserve a place in a workshop, along with the unresolved policy decisions that block a complete handoff.

scope.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.
Whether reservations require payment, an account, a capacity limit or cancellation handling is not yet decided, so these remain candidate decisions rather than settled scope.

requirements.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

stories.text: As a visitor, I want to reserve a place in a workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing workshop, when a visitor completes a reservation for a place in that workshop, then that reservation is recorded as a place held in that workshop for that visitor.
Given an existing workshop, when a visitor views that workshop after reserving, then the visitor can see that they hold a reserved place in it.

edge_cases.text: Whether a reservation must be refused when a workshop has no remaining places depends on the undecided capacity limit.
Whether a reserved place can be cancelled, and by whom, depends on the undecided cancellation policy.

dependencies.text: Reservations must be tied to a specific workshop offering, but no workshop catalogue or scheduling source has been given.
No owner or release date is assigned.

risks.text: Payment, account, capacity and cancellation policies are all undecided; implementing reservations without them may require rework once those decisions are made.

success_metrics.text: Verify that a visitor who completes a reservation for a workshop place subsequently appears as holding a reserved place in that workshop.

open_questions: Do reservations require payment, and if so, when is payment taken?
Do reservations require a visitor account, or can anonymous visitors reserve?
Is there a capacity limit per workshop, and what should happen when it is reached?
Can a reservation be cancelled, and if so, who may cancel it and by when?
Which workshop offerings are reservable, and where does workshop data come from?
Who owns this feature, and what release date applies?
Does a reservation need confirmation or notification to the visitor?
